name: desktop-foundation capability registry
description: Machine-readable registry for product projects and external AI agents integrating desktop-foundation.

capabilities.name: Package Consumption
capabilities.summary: Install all runtime packages, the CLI package, pnpm overrides, and aligned tarball versions from the selected foundation manifest.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own their package manager policy after copying the manifest blocks; the foundation only publishes tarballs and the manifest contract.

capabilities.name: App Shell
capabilities.summary: Wrap the product entry in DesktopAppShell and import the shared stylesheet once.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own routes, product pages, and API paths; DesktopAppShell only supplies common providers and shell contracts.

capabilities.name: Theme And Layout
capabilities.summary: Use theme presets, DesktopLayout, product adapter settings, and token overrides instead of copying foundation component internals.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own brand, menus, layout choices, and token values; the foundation owns reusable component structure and internal selectors.

capabilities.name: Login Shell
capabilities.summary: Use DesktopLoginPage and login templates when the product does not require a fully custom authentication UI.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own authentication fields, credentials, MFA, API calls, and error copy.

capabilities.name: Access Control
capabilities.summary: Expose permission and feature flags through DesktopAppShell, menus, commands, AccessGuard, and PermissionGuard.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own real authorization rules and backend enforcement; the foundation only hides and guards front-end entry points.

capabilities.name: I18n
capabilities.summary: Provide locale, dictionaries, safe missing-key diagnostics, and common number/date/currency formatters.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own business copy, field labels, domain dictionaries, currency defaults, and locale rollout policy.

capabilities.name: Errors And Request State
capabilities.summary: Normalize HTTP and runtime errors through DesktopError, DesktopErrorBoundary, useRequest, and useMutation.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own domain error codes and user-facing business remediation copy.

capabilities.name: Audit Events
capabilities.summary: Record foundation diagnostics and product action events with safe metadata through onAuditEvent, auditObserver, or client.diagnostics.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own log storage, retention, PII policy, and backend audit ingestion.

capabilities.name: HTTP And Upload
capabilities.summary: Use the bridge HTTP client for JSON, raw body, downloads, and multipart upload across Web and Tauri transports.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own endpoint paths, auth behavior, backend multipart parsing, object storage, and upload retention rules.

capabilities.name: Desktop Core
capabilities.summary: Wire desktop-core-rs and Tauri ACL permissions for HTTP, storage, secure storage, files, windows, clipboard, notifications, and downloads.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own platform signing, permissions beyond desktop-core:default, and native plugin choices.

capabilities.name: Updates
capabilities.summary: Use updateConfig, GitHub Releases manifest helpers, checksum verification, and an adapter boundary for real installation.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own release hosting, signing, notarization, rollout policy, and final native installer adapter.

capabilities.name: Link Proxy
capabilities.summary: Route arbitrary third-party URL requests through client.linkProxy with explicit proxy and target origin allowlists.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own allowed origins and must distinguish product API calls from arbitrary third-party link fetches.

capabilities.name: UI Overflow Guardrails
capabilities.summary: Use foundation table, drawer, modal, and layout components so long content and wide tables scroll inside the right container.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own page composition and column definitions; the foundation provides reusable overflow-safe components.

capabilities.name: CI And Release
capabilities.summary: Run desktop-foundation-ci for integration checks, package normalization, update manifests, release plans, and local release gates.
capabilities.businessBoundary: Products own CI provider, signing secrets, release approvals, and artifact publication.
